name: sanctions-kit-mcp-plugin
description: A MCP (My Computer, Personal) plugin for the SanctionsKit API. It allows users to perform searches and retrieve details about sanctioned entities directly from their local environment.

SANCTIONSKIT_API_KEY.description: Your API key for the SanctionsKit API. You can get one from the SanctionsKit website.

tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: Search for sanctioned entities based on various criteria.

q.description: The search query. Can be a name, address, or other identifying information.

countries.description: A list of 2-letter country codes to filter by.

type.description: The type of entity to search for.

tools.name: get_entity_details
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific sanctioned entity by its ID.

id.description: The unique identifier of the entity.

uvx.description: Install and run the plugin using uvx. Requires the SANCTIONSKIT_API_KEY environment variable to be set.

npm.description: Install and run the plugin using npx. Requires the SANCTIONSKIT_API_KEY environment variable to be set.

examples.title: Search for an Entity
examples.description: This example shows how to search for entities with the name 'John Doe'.
examples.prompt: Find any sanctioned individuals named John Doe.
